name: Dominick Paradise and the Sounds of Our Generation
reviewNotes:
Vocalist/tribute artist; "Our Generation" is the name of his show. Facebook/YouTube mentioned on his site without links.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Email published by him on his site for bookings and information. His site says "follow me on Facebook" but the icon links to Wix; search finds only a personal profile (facebook.com/dominick.paradise) that we did not record because it is a personal profile and could not be opened without login. No usable photos: his site images are flyers, collages (one with a Dreamstime stock watermark), small thumbnails, or snapshots with celebrities. His show banner (https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3b53c2_536487f35c9a46daa17708d898ff9f82~mv2.jpg, photo of him plus "presents the music of Frankie Valli" text) could serve as a logo-style image if the owner wants it; not recorded because it is mostly text. A Houston, Texas mention on a promoter page is from his past; current shows are all on Long Island/NYC.
description: Long Island singer who performs a Frankie Valli and the Four Seasons tribute plus other 1950s-70s favorites, doo-wop and Motown. He often sings at dinner dances in restaurants and lodges, with music for ballroom and social dancing.

evidence.note: His own site: Frankie Valli and the Four Seasons tribute show plus a second set of 50s-70s artists; asks people to email dominickparadise@gmail.com for bookings.
Brumidi Lodge (Sons of Italy), Deer Park: dinner dance with Dominick Paradise on Dec 4, 2026, music from the 60s-70s, Motown, doo-wop and ballroom.
Event listing site shows Oct 2026 dates at Brumidi Lodge (Deer Park), Gino's Trattoria (New Hyde Park), La Focaccia (Levittown) and a lodge in Mastic Beach.
YouTube channel "Dominick Paradise" with tribute videos (Tommy James, Neil Diamond, Johnny Rivers); the Tommy James video is linked from his Eisenhower Park event listing.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: dominickparadise.wixsite.com, sonsofitalyli.com, webtunes.com, youtube.com.
